description.narrative: Evermos (or the Company) is an Indonesian Sharia-compliant social commerce platform that connects brand principals (mainly Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)) to end-consumers via resellers. With a network of predominantly female resellers, the Company offers products from 1,000+ active brands to low-to-middle income consumers primarily in Tier 2-4 cities. The proposed investment would support Evermos growth initiatives in Indonesia.

IFC anticipates that the Project would result in improved access to markets for individuals and businesses, especially local SME manufacturers. The Project is also expected to result in micro-entrepreneurship opportunities for individuals, especially women. Beyond the Project, this investment has the potential to contribute to supporting the inclusiveness of the e-commerce sector in Indonesia, via competition and innovation channels, by scaling up a tech-enabled social commerce platform in Tier 2+ areas that typically host underserved consumers with limited digital trust.
